text: Dear Chair and Colleagues, Residents have expressed concerns with the length of the westbound queue on Blythwood Road approaching Mount Pleasant Road. To address this matter Transportation Services staff intend to designate a westbound left-turn lane on Blythwood Road at the intersection. In order to accommodate the left-turn lane and maintain two-way traffic it is necessary to prohibit parking at all times on the south side of Blythwood Road within 65.5 metres east of Mount Pleasant. Parking is currently prohibited within 30.5 metres east of Mount Pleasant Road.
North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the south side of Blythwood Road, between Mount Pleasant Road and a point 65.5 metres east.
